# First complete diagnostic path

Dopsy v0.1.0 is the first public development preview of the self-hosted,
read-only Docker diagnostic assistant.

## Highlights

- Ask questions about a container in a focused diagnostic chat.
- Let a tool-capable model investigate with bounded inspection, recent logs,
  and current resource statistics.
- See the Docker evidence behind each answer.
- Keep the application away from `docker.sock` through a dedicated,
  exact-allowlist proxy.
- Try the complete experience locally without Docker data or an API key.

## Try the local demo

```bash
git clone https://github.com/smn-pascal/dopsy.git
cd dopsy
cp .env.example .env
# Set DOPSY_DEMO_MODE=true in .env
docker compose up --build
```

Then open `http://localhost:8080`.

This release is an early development preview. Keep Dopsy bound to localhost;
authentication, historical metrics, and multi-host operation are not part of
v0.1.0. See the
[documentation](https://smn-pascal.github.io/dopsy/) and
[changelog](https://github.com/smn-pascal/dopsy/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for
details.
